source: Hand-written from 15-provider-driver.md §2.7, §4.10 and §6 and the ACP schema of @agentclientprotocol/sdk 1.6.0 (the pinned client); no agent or CLI was run. A generic ACP agent of the catalog (no provider): the common cases follow the synthetic Claude acp set of ../../../claude/acp/2.1.x-synthetic/ without its adapter-only parts (session modes, _meta options), and the cases of this driver are new: an option set with neither allow_once nor reject_once (F-ACP-NOREJECT), an agent that resumes with session/resume and no session/load, usage_update notifications beside the turn usage, and an agent that reports a session mode that skips the permission ask.

capabilities.agent: any ACP agent of the catalog, always the person’s own binary
capabilities.note: the synthetic row of AcpDriver.conformance.test.ts (interactive permission, form questions, resume per initialize, fidelity-1 usage)
